challenge.name: The Consent Gap
challenge.description: A new model version requires loyalty basket data, but the deployment pipeline lacks the governance controls to verify consent. #automation_alex# wants to push the automated deployment forward immediately to meet the promotion deadline, while #requirements_reuben# insists on a manual review process to ensure legal compliance. #automation_alex# is open to adding a manual approval step if it keeps the pipeline moving, but #requirements_reuben# will not accept any automated path without full audit trails.

output.content: I am pushing for a human review of the consent validation before the new model version is served. The current tooling misses subtle edge cases in the loyalty basket data that a careful eye catches immediately. I want this manual check to be a standard part of the pipeline, not a one off exception. The more thorough that review is, the better, because every missed consent flag creates a compliance risk we cannot afford during a promotion week. I am not asking to slow the deployment down indefinitely, but I do want the depth of that human scrutiny to increase as we scale. The goal is to make sure the consent check is as rigorous as the rest of our production standards, so we can trust the data flowing into the model.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that 'the more thorough that review is, the better' and requests increasing depth of scrutiny, indicating that exceeding the minimum request for a single check would make the author happier.
